hook.name: SLVR Swap Lottery Hook
hook.description: Hook for the SLVR/ETH pool that turns trading into a lottery. Exact-input swaps pay a tax (max 2%, owner-adjustable) in the input currency: buys pay ETH into an hourly jackpot draw and earn buy-weighted tickets; sells pay SLVR to in-range LP stakers. Optional hookData (address buyer, uint8 boost) attributes tickets and applies boosts. Exact-output swaps and partial fills revert. Only the owner can initialize the pool.
